posts.body:
Hi all, 

I am looking to wash some hand-me -down baby clothes as well as a secondhand Maxicosi cover. 

Interested in what others are using as their washing powder/ conditioner. Do some of you have your own natural concoctions that work to clean garments properly but are still soft on sensitive baby skin?

posts.body: I remember using Vigor Baby from Parknshop. We only separated baby's laundry for the first 6 months, and then included it in the regular family wash.
posts.body_with_quotes: I remember using Vigor Baby from Parknshop. We only separated baby's laundry for the first 6 months, and then included it in the regular family wash.

posts.body: I just use our regular ECOS liquid laundry detergent from City Super and set the machine to do an intensive rinse to make sure it's all washed out. I also did a pre-soak in a tub with Vanish (Napisan) for any second-hand whites, made them good as new.
